name: ENVIRONMENT (a service or the network did not answer)
CONTRACT_DRIFT (a response no longer matches its model)
LOCATOR_DRIFT (an element the test relies on is not on the page)
TIMING (a condition never became true in time)
TEST_DATA (seeding or cleanup failed)
messageRegex: (?s).*(not cleaned up|not deleted|still signs in|still answers).*

name: PRODUCT_BUG (the target did not do what the requirement says)
messageRegex: (?s)(?!.*(element\(s\) not found|not cleaned up|not deleted|still signs in|still answers)).*(assert|Locator expected).*
